Melo v0.0.1

The first release of Melo.

- Browse the music on your device and play it from one clean screen.
- A now-playing bar with artwork, seeking, and the usual transport controls.
- Media notifications with the controls you need while the phone is locked.
- An update screen that picks the build for your phone and shows what changed.

Thanks to everyone who tried Melo and reported what felt wrong.
